briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push multi-agent capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month as quarterly funding hit $14.9B. Multi-agent systems dominate deployments while regulatory scrutiny intensifies on autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 2.1T parameters focused on long-horizon planning. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B. DeepSeek-R2 achieved parity on coding benchmarks at 40% lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level through patent-pending multi-agent security protocols for CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and xAI announced joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas while TSMC began 2nm AI chip production ramp.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve reliable 1000-step autonomous agent operation before Q2 2027?
